QuestInfo.name: Remembering First Loves
QuestInfo.0: Something's up with Cassandra. She seems awfully...sentimental during this season of love. Go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Collect #b20 Faded Photographs, 20 Old Handkerchiefs, and 20 Old Pendants#k from normal monsters, and bring them to Cassandra. These mementos might just help her locate her first love...
QuestInfo.2: This is the season of love, where wishes and memories of love fill the air!

0.0: Oh, #b#h0##k, I'm glad you're here. They say this is the season of love...and they must be right. I just...started thinking about my first love, and now I can't stop.\n\nDo you remember your first love, #b#h0##k? Do you ever think about them? Maybe it's the season, but I really miss my first love... If only I knew where he was!  Hey...maybe you could...?
